highlights.description: 5 new product signal types for capturing customer and market intelligence: enhancement_request, competitive_gap, competitor_launch, analyst_finding, market_observation
`pkg/ref` package with `TypedRef` for cross-repo entity references (customer, capability, market, competitor, analyst-report)
Deterministic signal fingerprinting via `ComputeFingerprint()` for deduplication
Embedded JSON schemas via `go:embed` for runtime schema access without file I/O

added.description: Metadata key constants for enhancement signals: `MetaVotes`, `MetaSubscribers`, `MetaOrganizations`, `MetaCustomers`, `MetaOpportunities`, `MetaEstimatedARR`
Metadata key constants for cross-repo references: `MetaCustomerRef`, `MetaCapabilityRef`, `MetaMarketRef`, `MetaCompetitorRef`, `MetaAnalystReportRef`
`DerivedMetrics` struct for computed scores (frustration, momentum, reach, urgency) excluded from fingerprinting
`pkg/ref` package with `TypedRef` type and `Parse`, `Validate`, `ValidateStrict`, `ValidateSlug` functions for `{type}:{slug}` cross-repo references
`Entity.Ref` field for linking signal entities to external repository definitions via typed reference
`signal.ComputeFingerprint()` returning a deterministic SHA-256 digest of a signal's identity fields, excluding mutable/derived fields
`schema/` package with `go:embed` directives exposing `SignalSchema`, `RootCauseSchema`, `RemediationSchema`, and `ValidationSignalSchema` as `[]byte`

highlights.description: Initial release of signal-spec with core types, JSON schemas, XLSX export, and CLI

added.description: Core `Signal` type for atomic operational observations from external systems
Core `RootCause` type for persistent clustered operational issues with lifecycle states
Core `Remediation` and `ValidationSignal` types for tracking corrective actions and efficacy
JSON Schema generation from Go types with enum constraints
XLSX report generation with Domain Summary and Root Causes sheets
Leader mapping support for area/execution leader assignments

documentation.description: Example JSON files for signals, root causes, remediations, and leader mappings
README with CLI usage and project structure
Architecture documentation with data flow and design principles

tests.description: Unit tests for common types including tag validation
Unit tests for Signal type and JSON marshaling
Unit tests for RootCause type and lifecycle states
Unit tests for Remediation and ValidationSignal types
Unit tests for export package including XLSX generation
